title: 第5章 山鸟与鱼不同路第6章 少年可知世间有仙
slug: 凡人修仙捡个仙子做老婆
content_zh:
“各个大城都有验灵堂，每年都会举行升仙大会。也可前往灵宗，测验灵根。”
“你是灵宗的吗？”
“是。”
“我跟你去灵宗。”周元之前高攀不上，现在定然不会放手。何况他对灵途一无所知，有了她的帮助，修炼起来更容易。
“……”
女子看着面前少年，眼神复杂，虽然没有怨恨他，但也不可能就这样带他回灵宗，让人知晓他们之间发生的荒唐孽事。
“我有一法，可大致测验你的灵根。如果你只是一品灵根，没必要到灵宗。那里不收。”
“怎么测？”
“我可以帮你，但是我有一个条件。”
“说。”
“我们之间发生的事，彻底忘掉。如果我知道你跟任何人提起过，决不轻饶！”女子眼底泛起抹冷芒，紧紧盯着周元。
忘掉？
他都觉醒灵根了，难道还配不上她？
还是说他模样差？
都修仙了，还要看脸？
是，周元知道他们之间发生的事情是有些羞耻，但，毕竟有了肌肤之亲，夫妻之实啊。虽然他们现在还没有感情，但以后可以慢慢培养嘛。
日久生情。
村里都这样的。先成亲，再生情。
周元想说些什么，但张了张嘴还是忍住了。女子此刻冷漠的眼神清楚的告诉他，那不是开玩笑，如果泄露出去，怕是真杀了他。
周元忍了。

不提就不提。
但是忘掉是不可能的。
他初窥灵途，确实配不上她，但不代表以后没有机会。
三十年河东，三十年河西，莫欺少年穷。
等哪天他硬起来了，再去把她追回来。
“我可以答应。但我要知道你的名字。”
“不必了。我现在授你一套吞灵之法，你按照我说的，流转经脉，炼化天地灵气。”女子要通过周元炼化灵气的速度，推断灵根的强弱。
名字都不告诉吗？
这是真不想跟他有半点联系啊。
柔润的嘴唇里怎么能说出这么冷酷的话。
周元心里很无奈，
但是实力不济，只能忍了！
男人啊，永远是要靠实力说话的。
村里那些猎户，打到猎物回家的时候，走路都是仰着头的。
“我给你介绍下经脉。”
content_en:
"Every big city has a Ling Yuan Hall, and the Immortal Ascension Conference is held every year. You can also go to Ling Sect to test your spiritual roots."
"Are you from the Ling Sect?"
"Yes."
"I'll go to Lingzong with you." Zhou Yuan couldn't climb up to the top before, and he definitely won't let it go now. Besides, he knew nothing about the spiritual path, and with her help, it would be easier to practice.
"..."
The woman looked at the young man in front of her with complicated eyes. Although she didn't resent him, she couldn't just take him back to Lingzong and let people know about the ridiculous things that happened between them.
"I have a method that can roughly test your spiritual roots. If you only have a first-grade spiritual root, there is no need to go to Lingzong. They will not be accepted there."
"How to test?"
"I can help you, but I have a condition."
"Say."
"Forget what happened between us completely. If I know you mentioned it to anyone, I will never forgive you!" There was a cold light in the woman's eyes, and she stared at Zhou Yuan closely.
forget?
He has awakened his spiritual roots, is he still not worthy of her?
Or do you mean he looks bad?
You've already become an immortal, why should you care about your reputation?
Yes, Zhou Yuan was a little ashamed to know what happened between them, but after all, they had skin-to-skin contact, and they were husband and wife. Although they don't have feelings for each other yet, they can develop them gradually in the future.
Love grows over time.
The whole village is like this. Get married first, then fall in love.
Zhou Yuan wanted to say something, but he opened his mouth and held back. The woman's cold eyes at this moment clearly told him that it was not a joke, and if it was leaked, he would be killed.
Zhou Yuan endured it.
If you don’t mention it, don’t mention it.
But forgetting is impossible.
When he first glimpsed his spiritual path, he was indeed not worthy of her, but that didn't mean there wouldn't be opportunities in the future.
Thirty years in Hedong and thirty years in Hexi. Don’t bully young people into poverty.
Wait until one day when he gets hard, he can chase her back.
"I can agree. But I need to know your name."
"No need. I will now teach you a set of spirit-swallowing techniques. Follow my instructions, circulate your meridians, and refine the spiritual energy of heaven and earth." The woman wanted to use Zhou Yuan's speed of refining spiritual energy to deduce the strength of his spiritual roots.
Aren't you going to tell me your name?
I really don’t want to have any contact with him.
How could such cold words come out of those soft lips.
Zhou Yuan felt helpless,
But I am not strong enough, so I can only endure it!
Men, always rely on strength to speak.
The hunters in the village always walk with their heads raised when they return home from hunting.
"Let me introduce you to the meridians."
